skills.location: plugins/qamind/skills/<name>/SKILL.md (inside the plugin; no separate user-level folder)

mcp.registration: plugins/qamind/.mcp.json, wrapped form { "mcpServers": { ... } }, generated from core/mcp/servers.ts by hosts/claude/adapter.ts (claudeMcpConfig)

verified.how: a probe plugin with a stdio server named qa-memory, run with claude -p 2.1.312 from a separate project folder
facts: tool names keep the hyphen: mcp__plugin_<plugin>_qa-memory__<tool>
a bare server-level entry in allowed-tools / --allowedTools (mcp__plugin_<plugin>_qa-memory) pre-approves every tool of the server
the server process starts in the project folder and has CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR set
MCP tools are deferred: the agent loads them with one ToolSearch call before the first use
a skill's allowed-tools can list tools one by one, so a tool left out (fix_create_branch, fix_continue) makes the host ask the user

hooks.enforcement: guardrails for an active run are enforced by the PreToolUse hook; auto-QA (spec 9.5) is enforced by the Stop hook (gate rules, blocks with a reason so Claude continues) and the UserPromptSubmit hook (reads #qa, #qa-full, #qa-fix and #noqa and snapshots the project)

verified.how: a probe plugin with Stop and UserPromptSubmit hooks, run with claude -p 2.1.312, plus the hooks documentation
facts: Stop and UserPromptSubmit hooks run in headless claude -p, with no matcher
Stop stdin: session_id, transcript_path, cwd, prompt_id, permission_mode, effort, hook_event_name, stop_hook_active, last_assistant_message, background_tasks, session_crons
UserPromptSubmit stdin: session_id, transcript_path, cwd, prompt_id, permission_mode, hook_event_name, prompt (as typed, including a slash-command line)
stop_hook_active is false on the first Stop and true on the Stop that follows a block
{"decision":"block","reason":...} on Stop makes Claude continue with the reason as its instruction; Claude Code stops continuing after 8 blocked stops in a row (the count resets on tool calls)
Stop does not run when the user interrupts

a skill with user-invocable: false can be invoked by the model through the Skill tool (qamind:qa-auto-run); disable-model-invocation: true cannot, so the QA skills are not model-runnable and an internal skill is needed
systemMessage in a hook's JSON output reaches the user as an informational event
the hook process runs in the project folder with CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR set

qa-only.allowed-tools: Read Glob Grep Write(.qa/**) Edit(.qa/**) Bash(qamind *) Bash(curl *) Bash(git status *) Bash(git diff *) Bash(git log *) Bash(ls *) mcp__plugin_qamind_browser mcp__plugin_qamind_qa-memory
